info.name: ScreenCloud Studio API (GraphQL)
info.description: GraphQL operations for the ScreenCloud Studio API. Set graphqlEndpoint to the region-specific endpoint from Studio > Account Settings > DEVELOPER, and bearerToken to a token created on that same tab. All requests are HTTP POST with a GraphQL body.

variables.name: graphqlEndpoint
variables.description: Region-specific Studio GraphQL endpoint copied from the DEVELOPER tab.

variables.name: bearerToken
variables.description: Studio API token (Account Settings > DEVELOPER > New Token).

items.docs: Simplest query to confirm the endpoint and token work.

body.data: {"query":"query { currentOrg { id name } currentUser { id email } }"}

items.docs: Returns the org and user the token is scoped to.

body.data: {"query":"mutation($code: String!, $name: String, $spaceId: UUID) { pairScreen(pairingCode: $code, name: $name, spaceId: $spaceId) { id name deviceId } }","variables":{"code":"","name":"Lobby","spaceId":null}}

items.docs: Pairs a device using the pairing code shown on the screen.
Unpairs a screen, freeing its license.
Sets a screen to play a playlist.
Forces a screen to reload its content.

body.data: {"query":"mutation($name: String!, $spaceId: UUID!) { createPlaylist(name: $name, spaceId: $spaceId) { id name } }","variables":{"name":"New Playlist","spaceId":""}}

items.docs: Creates a playlist in a space.

body.data: {"query":"mutation($playlistId: UUID!, $fileId: UUID!, $durationMs: Int) { addFileToPlaylist(playlistId: $playlistId, fileId: $fileId, durationMs: $durationMs) { id } }","variables":{"playlistId":"","fileId":"","durationMs":10000}}

items.docs: Adds a media file to a playlist with a display duration.
Lists media files in the library.

body.data: {"query":"mutation($name: String!, $parentId: UUID) { createFolder(name: $name, parentId: $parentId) { id name } }","variables":{"name":"Campaign Assets","parentId":null}}

items.docs: Creates a folder to organize media.

body.data: {"query":"mutation($name: String!, $spaceId: UUID!) { createChannel(name: $name, spaceId: $spaceId) { id name } }","variables":{"name":"Lobby Channel","spaceId":""}}

{"query":"mutation($screenId: UUID!, $contentType: String!, $contentId: UUID!) { castStart(screenId: $screenId, contentType: $contentType, contentId: $contentId) { id startedAt } }","variables":{"screenId":"","contentType":"PLAYLIST","contentId":""}}

items.docs: Temporarily casts content to a screen.
Lists the signage app catalog available to the org.

body.data: {"query":"mutation($appId: UUID!, $name: String!, $spaceId: UUID!, $config: JSON) { createAppInstance(appId: $appId, name: $name, spaceId: $spaceId, config: $config) { id name status } }","variables":{"appId":"","name":"Weather NYC","spaceId":"","config":{}}}

items.docs: Creates a configured instance of an app to place in playlists/channels.

body.data: {"query":"query($screenId: UUID, $from: Datetime, $to: Datetime) { getPlaybackLogs(screenId: $screenId, from: $from, to: $to) { screenId contentType contentId startedAt endedAt durationMs } }","variables":{"screenId":null,"from":null,"to":null}}

items.docs: Proof-of-play: what played on which screen and when.
Returns an export (e.g. a download URL) of playback logs for a period.
